resources.string: Reads the on-screen text of Google Pay, PhonePe and Paytm only, to detect the amount, status and payee of a UPI payment so Paisa can track it for you. It does not read any other app or the UPI PIN screen, skips password fields, and keeps what it reads on this phone. If you have a monthly budget, it can show a warning over the Pay screen when a payment would go over today\'s allowance; its only action on screen is pressing Back when you tap Cancel on that warning.
You have spent ₹%1$s today. Paying ₹%2$s brings it to ₹%3$s, over today\'s allowance of ₹%4$s.
This is a warning only: it cannot stop the payment.
